mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, locker_number, locker_type FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ORDER BY locker_number

SELECT a.locker_number, a.locker_type, b.reservation_step FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING A LEFT JOIN UNTACT_BOOK_RESERVATION B ON a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND a.locker_number = b.locker_number AND b.round_idx = (SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_end_date = (SELECT round_start_date FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE 1=1 AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = #{round_idx} ) ) WHERE a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT locker_number, locker_type FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT NVL(MAX(locker_number), 0) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND locker_type = '도서대출'

SELECT homepage_id, locker_use_yn, row_count, total_count, round_start_date, round_end_date, reservation_repeated_day, SUBSTR(reservation_repeated_time,0,2) AS start_hour, SUBSTR(reservation_repeated_time,4,2) AS start_minute, locker_use_type, terms FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING a USING dual ON (a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.locker_use_yn = #{locker_use_yn}, a.row_count = #{row_count}, a.total_count = #{total_count}, a.round_start_date = #{round_start_date}, a.round_end_date = #{round_end_date}, a.reservation_repeated_day = #{reservation_repeated_day}, a.reservation_repeated_time = #{start_hour}||':'||#{start_minute}, a.locker_use_type = #{locker_use_type}, a.terms = #{terms} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( homepage_id, locker_use_yn, row_count, total_count, round_start_date, round_end_date, reservation_repeated_day, reservation_repeated_time, locker_use_type, terms ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{locker_use_yn}, #{row_count}, #{total_count}, #{round_start_date}, #{round_end_date}, #{reservation_repeated_day}, #{start_hour}||':'||#{start_minute}, #{locker_use_type}, #{terms} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') < TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(loan_time,0,2)||':'||SUBSTR(loan_time,4,2)) OR TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') > TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(loan_time,7,2)||':'||SUBSTR(loan_time,10,2)))
SELECT reservation_max_count FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT loan_time FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT locker_use_type FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT NVL(MAX(total_count),0) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT locker_use_yn FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}

SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(round_start_date||round_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(round_end_date||round_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS')

SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND ROUND_END_DATE = (SELECT ROUND_START_DATE FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE 1=1 AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(round_start_date||round_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(round_end_date||round_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS'))

SELECT round_idx FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND ROUND_END_DATE = (SELECT ROUND_START_DATE FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE 1=1 AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = #{round_idx})

SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(round_start_date||round_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:mi'),'YYYYMMDDHH24miss') AS round_start_date, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(round_end_date||round_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:mi'),'YYYYMMDDHH24miss') AS round_end_date FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = #{round_idx}
SELECT round_end_date||' '||round_end_time AS round_end_date FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND round_idx = #{round_idx}
SELECT reservation_repeated_day FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_ROUND WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND #{round_start_date} BETWEEN TO_DATE(round_start_date||round_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(round_end_date||round_end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DDHH24:MI:SS')
